```python
# For each digit, finds when the last reel can be stopped on it (one press per second) and prints the best digit's time
n=int(input())

    for x in range(10):

        time[s_x].append(i+(count[s_x][x]-1)*10)
ans=10**100
for i in range(10):
    ans=min(ans,max(time[i]))
print(ans)
```
